title: Replay product policy from recorded facts and signals
narrative: Taloneth needs deterministic policy replay from recorded facts and signals without re-running tools — so offline audits match live verdicts. Policy replay for Dots MH-DOTS-09; unified review audit: `nubble_insp_review_audit_reconstruct`[^insp-dots-09-replay].
implementation:
`replay_verdict` in `mechaharness.decision_log` re-runs `decide()` on recorded facts/signals/policy for deterministic audits.

Covers: OBS-03.
validation: Harness `decision_plane` op `policy_replay` → `_run_policy_replay`. Soft expects: identical verdict kind on replay. Unit: decision_log / judgement_policy tests.
